//: Template only. Copy values into User Secrets or environment variables; never commit real secrets.

Secrets.//: Signing private keys as PEM text, keyed by SigningKey.PrivateKeyReference. Put real values in User Secrets or env (Secrets__<name>).

SecretFiles.//: Alternative: a path to a PEM file per PrivateKeyReference, e.g. "signing-key-1": "C:/keys/signing-key-1.pem".

Errors.//: Only honored in the Development environment; responses never carry exception details anywhere else.

RateLimiting.//: Defaults shown for Login; also Refresh, Register, ForgotPassword, ResetPassword. Paths maps request paths to these kinds.

ForwardedHeaders.//: Only list the reverse proxies in front of the API. Empty (default) means X-Forwarded-For is ignored.
